                 errors at setup, and none passes or fails;

                 "1 code state" and nothing else, as in the log.

    uv run --group measure python <this file> control
    uv run --group measure python <this file> edit

The probe is created only in this worktree and always removed (finally). The script refuses to start
if the probe exists or src/, uv.lock or pyproject.toml has uncommitted changes.

import re
import subprocess
import sys
import threading

OUT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "repro-out"

    """Create PROBE once the second S protocol's run 1 has written run.json (position 4, between runs)."""
    while not stop.is_set():
        if len(list(basetemp.glob("batches*/batch-1/S/**/run-*-1/run.json"))) >= 2:
            PROBE.write_text("# diagnostic probe; deleted by repro_mid_batch_edit.py\n")
            log["probe_written_utc"] = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime())

        stop.wait(0.05)

    last = [line for line in output.splitlines() if line.strip()][-1]

        errors = log["counts"].get("errors", log["counts"].get("error", 0))
        log["diagnostic_paths"] = named
        log["collector"] = collector_signature(basetemp)
        verdict = ("probe_written_utc" in log and named == [repr([PROBE_KEY])] and errors > 0
                   and not {"passed", "failed"} & log["counts"].keys() and log["collector"]["matches_logged_signature"])
    log["verdict"] = "as expected" if verdict else "UNEXPECTED"
    (out / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(log, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps(log, indent=2))
    assert not PROBE.exists() and subprocess.run(["git", "status", "--porcelain", "--", "src"], capture_output=True,
                                                 text=True, check=True).stdout == "", "src/ not clean afterwards"
    return 0 if verdict else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else ""))

refuses to start if the probe already exists or if src/ has uncommitted changes.
"""
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path.cwd()
sys.path[:0] = [str(REPO / "tests"), str(REPO / "analysis")]
import numpy as np  # noqa: E402
from conftest import nyse_sessions, write_snapshot  # noqa: E402

import collect_baseline_measurements as cbm  # noqa: E402
from etf_risk import measure  # noqa: E402
from etf_risk.windows import build_definitions, write_definitions  # noqa: E402

PROBE = REPO / "src" / "etf_risk" / "_flake_probe.py"
ANCHOR, REPEATS = "2024-01-02", 2


def windows(root: Path) -> Path:            # as the test's `windows` fixture
    rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
    dates = nyse_sessions(ANCHOR, 61)
    b = rng.normal(0, 0.02, 60)
    b[29] = -0.60
    snap = write_snapshot(root, "snap", {"AAA": (dates, rng.normal(0, 0.02, 60)), "BBB": (dates, b)},
                          unverified=[{"ticker": "BBB", "date": str(dates[30])}])
    return write_definitions(*build_definitions(snap, "rolling", window_days=10, stride=3, anchor=ANCHOR), root / "w")


def watch_and_edit(batch: Path, stop: threading.Event, log: dict) -> None:
    """Create PROBE once the second S protocol's run 1 has written run.json (position 4, between runs)."""
    while not stop.is_set():
        if len(list((batch / "S").rglob("run-*-1/run.json"))) >= 2:
            PROBE.write_text("# diagnostic probe; deleted by repro_mid_batch_edit.py\n")
            log["edited_at"] = time.time()
            return
        stop.wait(0.05)


def build_batch(batch: Path, w: Path) -> None:   # as the test's `batch` fixture
    lines = ["\t".join(cbm.POSITION_FIELDS)]
    for position, engine in enumerate(cbm.ORDER, start=1):
        out = batch / engine
        before = set(out.rglob("protocol-*.json"))
        assert measure.main(["--pipeline", cbm.ENGINES[engine], "--repeats", str(REPEATS), "--",
                             "--windows", str(w), "--out-root", str(out)]) == 0
        (protocol,) = set(out.rglob("protocol-*.json")) - before
        lines.append("\t".join([str(position), engine, protocol.stem.removeprefix("protocol-"), "0",
                                "ok" if not cbm.check_protocol(protocol, engine) else "failed", "2026-10-22T00:00:00Z"]))
    (batch / "positions.tsv").write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
    for path in batch.rglob("*.json"):
        record = json.loads(path.read_text())
        if "code" in record:
            record["code"]["git_worktree_clean"] = True
            path.write_text(json.dumps(record))


def main(arm: str) -> int:
    assert arm in ("control", "edit"), "arm: control | edit"
    assert not PROBE.exists(), f"{PROBE} exists; remove it first"
    dirty = subprocess.run(["git", "status", "--porcelain", "--", "src", "uv.lock", "pyproject.toml"],
                           capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
    assert dirty == "", f"hashed paths have changes; refusing:\n{dirty}"
    stop, log = threading.Event(), {}
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="flake-repro-") as tmp:
        root = Path(tmp)
        w, batch = windows(root / "snap"), root / "batches" / "batch-1"
        watcher = threading.Thread(target=watch_and_edit, args=(batch, stop, log), daemon=True)
        try:
            if arm == "edit":
                watcher.start()
            build_batch(batch, w)
        finally:
            stop.set()
            PROBE.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        _, acceptance = cbm.collect(batch, w, REPEATS)
        failing = {k: c["problems"] for k, c in acceptance["criteria"].items() if not c["ok"]}
        p4 = acceptance["used_protocols"].get("4")
        print(json.dumps({"arm": arm, "probe_written": "edited_at" in log, "position_4": p4,
                          "all_ok": acceptance["all_ok"], "failing": failing}, indent=2))
        if arm == "control":
            verdict = acceptance["all_ok"]
        else:
            expected = {f"protocol {p4}: source or dependency hashes differ",
                        f"run-{p4}-2: source or dependency hashes differ"}
            got = {p.split(" from ")[0] for p in failing.get("1 code state", [])}
            verdict = got == expected and set(failing) == {"1 code state"}
        print("REPRODUCES THE LOGGED SIGNATURE" if arm == "edit" and verdict else
              "CONTROL CLEAN" if verdict else "UNEXPECTED: see 'failing' above")
    return 0 if verdict else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else ""))
